title: Save Status
summary: Makes autosave honest: an aging "Saved · 2 min ago", a clear offline state and Retry on error, so failures aren't silent.
description: Autosave status with an aging "Saved · 2 min ago", an honest offline state and Retry on error, plus a debounced useAutosave hook that runs one save at a time and always saves the newest value last.
catches: Saves that failed, shown with Retry
Being offline, instead of a misleading "Saved"
How long ago the last save landed
Out-of-order saves (one at a time, newest value goes next)
Leaving with unsynced changes (optional beforeunload warning)
limits: The offline draft is kept in localStorage on this device only, if you enable it
Concurrent edits from other tabs or users are not merged
a11y: Status text in a polite live region; errors announced with role=alert
Exact save time available in a title tooltip
Retry is a real button; icons are aria-hidden
server: Reject stale writes with a version or ETag check so an older save can't overwrite a newer one.
